facts.fact: Law n° 2016-48 of 11 July 2016 on banks and financial institutions was adopted by parliament on 9 June 2016 and promulgated, and its Articles 20 and 21 set the framework for payment services and payment establishments.
facts.system: Loi n° 2016-48 relative aux banques et aux établissements financiers

facts.fact: Article 20 of Law 2016-48 has payment services run by a resident financial institution as a specialised payment establishment, which is not a bank, with minimum capital of 5 million dinars under Article 32.
facts.system: Loi n° 2016-48 relative aux banques et aux établissements financiers
